interpretation: Unmodified D repeat: the exact same DLL and native Host completed another 80 records. A/B/C controls are retained from their original earlier runs, not rerun concurrently. Large initial D geometry outliers did not recur, but some full-frame rotation regressions remain against earlier controls. The original negative R2 run remains published separately. This repeat is not evidence of a causal code fix or final performance acceptance; a nearby old-arm baseline repeat is required.
